methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

apatosaurus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Apatosaurus has 1 high-priority matchup where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. None of those matchups offers a reliable speed-based disengage once contact is forced.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

specialRisks.title: Cannibalism / offspring risk
specialRisks.summary: Ceratosaurus are not cannibalistic and will never eat the bodies of a fallen Ceratosaurus, whether it be a pack member or stranger whelp.

evidence.text: Ceratosaurus are not cannibalistic and will never eat the bodies of a fallen Ceratosaurus, whether it be a pack member or stranger whelp.

specialRisks.title: Same-species territory risk
specialRisks.summary: Ceratosaurus refuse to share POIs with other packs of Ceratosaurus, but are not territorial towards them. While two opposing packs may share aggressive calls and posture at one another, it will never escalate into an engagement.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

deinonychus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Deinonychus has 6 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. Against 2 listed threats, speed still provides a reliable disengage option.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

specialRisks.title: Same-species territory risk
specialRisks.summary: Deinosuchus males are highly territorial, controlling a patch of water which they drive out other males from. Females are sedentary, and are allowed to swim between different male territories, but stop being permitted if a male is paired with a female already.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

specialRisks.title: Cannibalism / offspring risk
specialRisks.summary: Dilophosaurus are tolerant towards other groups of Dilophosaurus. Dilophosaurus are passive towards all other species. Dominant males in leashes may attempt to cannibalize unattended ungrouped Dilophosaurus offspring.

evidence.text: Dilophosaurus are tolerant towards other groups of Dilophosaurus. Dilophosaurus are passive towards all other species. Dominant males in leashes may attempt to cannibalize unattended ungrouped Dilophosaurus offspring.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

eotriceratops.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Eotriceratops has 6 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. None of those matchups offers a reliable speed-based disengage once contact is forced.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

giganotosaurus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Giganotosaurus has 5 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. Against 1 listed threat, speed still provides a reliable disengage option.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

specialRisks.title: Same-species territory risk
specialRisks.summary: When encountering other herbivorous species that they do not herd with, they attempt to control food and water, and can engage in resource challenges. This is especially true against ceratopsians.

evidence.text: When encountering other herbivorous species that they do not herd with, they attempt to control food and water, and can engage in resource challenges. This is especially true against ceratopsians.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

specialRisks.title: Same-species territory risk
specialRisks.summary: Male Lurdusaurus patrol the float's territory both day and night, eager to drive out any rival male Lurdusaurus, and other semi-aquatic species.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

maip.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Maip has 6 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. None of those matchups offers a reliable speed-based disengage once contact is forced.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

pachycephalosaurus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Pachycephalosaurus has 6 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. None of those matchups offers a reliable speed-based disengage once contact is forced.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

specialRisks.title: Mutation-specific risk
specialRisks.summary: Quetzalcoatlus may hunt up to Medium tier if solo, and Large or Albino Apexes if grouped. Any Quetzalcoatlus may hunt offspring of adolescent or below of any tier. methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

sarcosuchus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Sarcosuchus has 7 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. Against 4 listed threats, speed still provides a reliable disengage option.

specialRisks.title: Cannibalism / offspring risk
specialRisks.summary: Sarcosuchus can group up to 3 Sub/Adults with unlimited offspring and  unlimited adoptees. These groups are called a float. Only males adopt - females may cannibalize unrelated Sarcosuchus of adolescent and below.

evidence.text: Sarcosuchus can group up to 3 Sub/Adults with unlimited offspring and  unlimited adoptees. These groups are called a float. Only males adopt - females may cannibalize unrelated Sarcosuchus of adolescent and below.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

spinosaurus-saltwater.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Spinosaurus (Saltwater) has 4 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. None of those matchups offers a reliable speed-based disengage once contact is forced.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

styracosaurus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Styracosaurus has 6 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. Against 1 listed threat, speed still provides a reliable disengage option.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

tenontosaurus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Tenontosaurus has 6 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. None of those matchups offers a reliable speed-based disengage once contact is forced.

Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

tylosaurus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Tylosaurus has 2 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. Against 2 listed threats, speed still provides a reliable disengage option.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

tyrannosaurus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Tyrannosaurus has 5 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. None of those matchups offers a reliable speed-based disengage once contact is forced.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

tyrannotitan.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Tyrannotitan has 3 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. Against 2 listed threats, speed still provides a reliable disengage option.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

utahraptor.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Utahraptor has 5 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. Against 1 listed threat, speed still provides a reliable disengage option.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.

yutyrannus.summary: Played solo against their full legal groups, Yutyrannus has 6 high-priority matchups where fight maths, pursuit and profile intent align. None of those matchups offers a reliable speed-based disengage once contact is forced.

methodology.intent: Profile-specific hunt, prey, rivalry and avoidance rules are checked before tier eligibility.
methodology.pursuit: Relevant land, water or flight caps and sprint duration determine whether contact can be forced.
methodology.groups: By default you are solo and the other side brings its full legal group; both sides can be set to any size up to the profile caps. Unlimited groups are never turned into an invented number.
methodology.fight: Every hit is resolved as damage × (attacker CW ÷ victim CW) ÷ victim armour from the adult stat curves. Each side focus-fires one target at a time with its best spammable attack plus up to two stronger abilities. Times assume every swing lands, so agile, smaller players outperform them by dodging. Bleed stacks, ignores armour and blocks healing; it is shown as pressure and only converted into health when you switch on the estimate, because that rate is not documented.
methodology.encounter: Mapped area overlap lowers or raises relevance, but an explicit cross-species rule can override sparse map overlap.
